ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee and pay it to the driver; no notification-duty reminder needed (driver messaged at 18:18 and called at 18:19 before cancelling).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat (F10–F12), the driver's statement (F15) and the complaint describe waiting and a prompt to come down ("so slow") — impatience, not a threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous driving. No safety clause applies; safety_concern = none.

Merits (NS-0 → NS-1): the driver cancelled, and the record shows the cancellation was for rider no-show — he tapped "I'm Here" (F7), then said "waited 5 min already, you never come, cancelling" (F12). Because the driver's words in the chat decide the reason and match no-show, NS-1 (not NS-3) governs.

NS-1 conditions, each on system records:
(i) Arrival: "I'm Here" tapped 18:17:45 with GPS 40 m from pickup [F7], first within 200 m at 18:17:10 [F2] — within the 200 m radius. Met.
(ii) Free wait: arrival 18:17:45 (later than the 18:15:00 acceptance/scheduled time) [F4][F6]; cancellation 18:23:25 = 5 min 40 s of waiting, past the 5-minute free wait. Met.
(iii) Contact attempts: 3 in-app messages (first 18:18:15) and 1 in-app call (18:19:15, not answered, per F14) — at least one message and one call before cancelling [F5][F13]. Met.
(iv) Continuous presence: stationary at the pickup 18:17:45–18:23:25, and within 200 m for 5 min 40 s, no GPS gap [F2][F3][F7]. Met.

All four conditions hold, so the $5.00 fee stands [F4][F8]. Surge is 1.0× and no other charge is in dispute [F9]; no route deviation is at issue, so RD clauses do not apply.

TH-2 makes no-show/cancellation rulings system-final at the fixed $5.00. The rider's fraud flag [F19] raises the confidence threshold to 95% (TH-3/C5); the record here is complete (GPS, timeline, timestamped messages, driver's no-show reason) and exactly one rule row applies, so the threshold is still met. The driver's two prior upheld no-show disputes [F20] are not a current-case breach — the fee stands and no RD-6/NS-2 flag is triggered, since nothing was voided and no false arrival was marked. The rider's hardship is noted, but the driver complied with the waiting and contact requirements.

element_findings.element: Reason the driver cancelled (NS-0: no-show vs other)
element_findings.reason: Driver's own chat words at 18:23 ('you never come, cancelling') and his statement show a rider no-show cancellation, so NS-1 applies rather than NS-3.

element_findings.element: NS-1(i) arrival confirmed within 200 m of pickup
element_findings.reason: 'I'm Here' tapped 18:17:45 at 40 m (closest approach 21 m); inside the 200 m radius on GPS.
Arrival 18:17:45, cancellation 18:23:25 — 5 min 40 s, counted from the later of scheduled pickup and arrival.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iii) at least 1 in-app message AND 1 in-app call before cancelling
element_findings.reason: 3 timestamped messages (first 18:18:15) and 1 in-app call (18:19:15, unanswered) all before the 18:23:25 cancellation.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iv) driver remained at the pickup point throughout
element_findings.reason: Stationary 18:17:45–18:23:25 at 40 m from pickup, within 200 m for 5 min 40 s; no GPS gap.
Surge multiplier 1.0× throughout (no surge change), so no surge notice was required.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider says the driver 'kept rushing me' — the chat does show impatience (F11 'so slow'), but the driver's arrival, 5 min 40 s wait and pre-cancellation message + call satisfy every NS-1 condition, so the $5.00 fee is not voided.

Rider says the driver cancelled 'just as I was coming down'; the record shows the free wait had already expired (5 min 40 s after arrival) when the driver cancelled, so this does not defeat the no-show fee.
